input.comment: [Playbook] We moved governing law to New York so it matches the agreed New York venue, and confirmed exclusive jurisdiction in the state and federal courts in New York County. If you prefer, we can accept Delaware or California law and courts as a fallback, but law and forum should be aligned; please also confirm that Section 8 arbitration is subordinate to this exclusive court venue and, if retained, is seated in New York.
input.summary: Change governing law from Delaware to New York and confirm New York County venue.
